title: Sound picker, round 16: the two bosses
intro: The Orb-Weaver Matron's and the Crystal Colossus's own sounds (2026-11-24), for their reworked fights. Not in the game yet.

groups.name: The Orb-Weaver Matron
groups.note: She hangs, spits and dives; the ram flings her to the wall.

groups.name: The Crystal Colossus
groups.note: Three crystal plates; a cart breaks a hot one and clangs off a cold one.

cues.name: Matron: the hiss
cues.where: Hanging high in round 2, before she spits or dives; her cocoon's threat in rounds 1 and 3

options.label: Long raspy hiss
options.note: A giant spider queen hissing a threat from above: a long harsh raspy hiss with wet clicking mandibles, menacing, close mic, dry, no reverb, no human voice, no music

options.label: Chitter into a hiss
options.note: A huge spider rearing up to strike: rapid dry chittering clicks of chitin fangs rising into a sharp sputtering hiss, insect, menacing, close mic, dry, no human voice, no music

cues.name: Matron: the shriek
cues.where: The ram catches her mid-dive, a blast tears her cocoon, the last blow

options.label: Shrill screech
options.note: A giant spider monster struck hard and shrieking in pain: a harsh shrill screeching chitter, insect-like, raw and furious, about one second, close mic, dry, no human voice, no music

options.label: Grating rasp
options.note: A huge beetle-like spider screams: a grating, rasping high screech with clattering chitin, monstrous, short, close mic, dry, no human voice, no music

cues.name: Matron: she lands
cues.where: Her dive lands, or she crashes to the floor on her back after the ram

options.label: Fleshy thud and chitin
options.note: A huge heavy spider body crashes onto a stone floor from a height: one heavy fleshy thud with a dry crunch of chitin shell and legs clattering on stone, dry, no reverb, no voice

cues.name: Colossus: the stomp
cues.where: His stomp lands (it puts out the nearest brazier); also his landing from the wall

options.label: Rock boom and crystal
options.note: A giant stone golem stomps one huge foot on a rocky cave floor: one massive deep low boom of rock on rock with crunching gravel and a few crystal shards tinkling, dry, short tail, no voice

options.label: Earth-shaking thump
options.note: An enormous rock giant slams his foot down: a deep earth-shaking thump with a gravelly crunch and pebbles bouncing, heavy sub bass, dry, no reverb, no voice

cues.name: Colossus: the roar
cues.where: He wakes, a plate bursts, he leaps onto the wall

options.label: Grinding boulder roar
options.note: A huge golem made of rock and crystal roars in anger: a deep grinding rumbling roar like boulders scraping together, gravelly and resonant with a faint glassy ring, monstrous, no human voice, no music

cues.name: Colossus: a plate bursts
cues.where: The cart hits a brittle (glowing) plate: it shatters for good

options.label: Glassy crack and shards
options.note: A thick slab of crystal armour shatters from a blow: one bright loud glassy crack bursting into many crystal shards scattering and tinkling on a stone floor, close mic, dry, no voice

options.label: Hot crystal burst
options.note: A big block of hot brittle crystal explodes: a sharp crack and crunch with a glassy burst and a short hiss of heat, shards raining on stone, close mic, dry, no voice

cues.name: Colossus: a cold plate clangs
cues.where: The cart hits a cold plate: it holds, and he staggers

options.label: Ringing crystal clang
options.note: A heavy iron mine cart rams a thick crystal armour plate on a stone golem: one deep ringing crystal clang with a heavy iron knock, the crystal ringing briefly, dry, no voice
